mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) increases risk of trazodone-related orthostatic hypotension and cardiac arrhythmias; additive hypotensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum electrolytes, and cardiac status; ensure adequate potassium and sodium levels; consider dose adjustment if orthostatic hypotension or arrhythmias develop.
